mission: SNKRDUNK fix 3 step 1 (owner 'go perfectionist' 2026-11-03): fresh Bandai evidence for the product labels of the 37 new SNKRDUNK listings (all stored with no set code and no proposal). The label tables' evidence standard re-derives rows from a frozen Bandai catalogue that is not in the repository and whose Asia-EN half is gone (catalogue_import.py), so this read-only runbook captures both Bandai series pickers and the coded OP/EB/PRB series pages and tests each stored SNKRDUNK label against checks 1 to 3. It decides nothing; label rows follow in a reviewed PR.

impacts.reason: New read runbook bandai-label-evidence: about 50 requests to Bandai's official card lists through the existing collector fetcher (honest User-Agent, 2 s apart, stops on 401/403/429/451), plus one SELECT of SNKRDUNK candidate titles on the read-only session. No DB write, no price-source request.
Label verdicts against both catalogues, membership comparison, compact runs, registration. 97 ops tests pass (Postgres 16).

routes: Bandai official card lists (JP and Asia-EN), read-only staging Postgres session

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: The report is wrong or Bandai refuses the reads.
